reasoning: Both forward and backward kernels exhibit f_lockstep(W) = 1.0 for all W ∈ {4, 8, 16}. The maximum feasible subgroup width is W = 16.

forward.lockstep_mechanism: uniform uint4 LDS of b_idx from warp_queue; same gaussian index for all 32 lanes

backward.lockstep_mechanism: uniform smem index t for conic_batch[t], xy_opacity_batch[t]; same gaussian for all 128 threads
backward.gradient_scatter: warpSum reduction → single atomicAdd per gaussian per warp (lane 0)

mapping_compatibility.note: Pixel mappings differ (forward: lane→(x,y) grid; backward: warp→row-band, lane→column) but QSCAN operates on per-gaussian lockstep, which is identical in both passes.

probe_methodology: Source-level structural proof. The lockstep property is a theorem about the code: the drain loop (forward) and t-loop (backward) use a single uniform loop variable with no per-lane branching on gaussian selection.
